label: TSMM to DCAS binding
description: Maps DTG Conformance & Assurance System (DCAS) concepts into TSMM abstractions for assurance, evidence, and evaluation workflows.

mappings.description: Normative expectation used to govern evaluation and downstream trust effects.
Structured evidence set used to substantiate conformance and assurance posture.
Formal evaluation activity over declared controls and observed evidence.
Profile defining rigor, evidence depth, and assessment expectations.
Actor evaluating whether evidence and controls are sufficient in context.

notes: DCAS is assurance-heavy and maps most directly into the policy, evidence, assessment, and profile surfaces of TSMM.
This binding is semantic and explanatory. It does not replace DCAS terminology or normative requirements.
